newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end down on NCD maturation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end down on NCD maturation.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Friday as liquidity in the banking system got a boost ahead of Saturday's maturation of T$10 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.992 percent against Thursday's 5.072 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.90-4.95 against 5.00. Dealers expected the rates to remain at a low level next week.
In the bond market, the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.6200-5.6300 against 5.6300-5.6325 and the 10-year 86/1 bond yield was at 5.6400-5.6500. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
